rule: Canonical files are training_data JSON files whose names contain no space. Files with a space in the name (reused indexes such as '00268_quartz 2.json') are excluded and not copied. Train = canonical files that are not the held-out material and not the held-out laser. Test = canonical files that are the held-out material or the held-out laser (union). A file that is both is copied once, into test. Held-out material is calcite (mode card calcite_simplified.json). Held-out laser is 632.8 nm because it is the only laser whose plasma lines are real neon lines. This follows the README and ARCHITECTURE exclusion rule. SEQUENCE_OF_EXECUTION.md step 4 also lists clean Valency peak lists and the Lee et al. MoS2 list; those files are not in training_data and are not part of this copy. training_data is only read, never modified.
held_out_laser_reason: 632.8 nm is the only laser whose plasma lines are real neon lines.
